subject: Echoware pilot: extension request, procurement asks, and proposed path
messages:
From: Lina Park <lina.park@echoware.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Echoware Redwood eval — extension & budget

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team ran a quick internal trial and we’ve hit some integration blockers that mean we need a little more runway to validate the RAG flow across our anonymized dataset. Procurement is also flagging that our budget cadence closes at month end, so we’re asking whether Redwood can provide a 2-week extension on the current POC window (same environment, same allocation).

Concretely: can you extend the timebox by 14 days? If possible, we’d prefer a credit or invoice-level discount rather than a one-off free extension (procurement needs something they can reference on the PO). Also important: we need basic SSO notes and SOC2 evidence to satisfy our security review before we sign any PO.

I attached a short doc describing the remaining validation work and acceptance checkpoints (pilot_requirements.docx). Happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Thanks,
Lina Park
Director, Data Platform — Echoware
Lina Park | lina.park@echoware.com

Attachments: pilot_requirements.docx (docx)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@echoware.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 13:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Echoware Redwood eval — extension & budget

Hi Lina — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the requirements. Looping Jordan (sales) and David (eng) to cover commercial and SSO/ops details.

Short answer: we can get you the extra 14 days. Options we can offer quickly:

- Option A (procurement-friendly): provide a 30% invoice credit applied to the pilot invoice if a PO referencing the pilot is issued by Echoware within 14 days of the original pilot end date.
- Option B (timebox-first): extend the environment by 14 days at no additional cost; in exchange, Echoware signs a non-binding LOI/intent to purchase a paid pilot (30-day conversion window).

We will also share our SOC2 summary and a short SSO integration guide in a separate attachment — David, can you confirm whether the SSO notes in the guide cover the minimal items Lina called out?

Attached: redwood_proposal_v2.pdf and SOC2_summary.pdf.

If procurement prefers invoice-level credit (Option A) we can coordinate with Finance to show how it will be reflected on the PO/invoice. If they need a contractual redline, we can accept a short redline window (we try to avoid long-form amendments for pilots).

Next steps: tell me which option procurement prefers and I’ll start paperwork and a short onboarding for SSO. If you want, we can schedule a 20-minute call this afternoon.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood_proposal_v2.pdf (pdf), SOC2_summary.pdf (pdf)

From: Lina Park <lina.park@echoware.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Echoware Procurement <procurement@echoware.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Echoware Redwood eval — extension & budget

Marcus / Jordan — thanks. Procurement is explicit that any concession needs to be visible on the PO/invoice (they don’t accept LOIs in lieu of invoice credits). Their preference is: an invoice credit line item (Option A) or a pre-invoiced discount applied to the pilot invoice. They will not sign an LOI as the primary commercial term.

Procurement also asked for:
- SOC2 report or at minimum executive summary (for now we can accept the summary you attached but they may request the full report through the evidence portal).
- SSO configuration notes and a contact for engineering to schedule a 1-hour integration session (we’ll need that as part of our security gate).
- A sample SOW or short addendum they can attach to the PO describing deliverables and acceptance criteria.

Attaching procurement_terms.pdf (their internal template) for reference. Procurement (copied) — can you confirm the exact wording you need on the PO to accept an invoice credit?

On timing: if you can surface the invoice credit mechanics by EOD tomorrow, procurement will try to route the PO for signature by month end.

Thanks,
Lina

Attachments: procurement_terms.pdf (pdf)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@echoware.com>, Echoware Procurement <procurement@echoware.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Echoware Redwood eval — extension & budget

Hi Lina / Procurement team — thanks for the clarity and for sending the template. I’m Jordan on Sales Ops; I’ll propose a path that keeps procurement happy and minimizes paperwork friction:

- Commercial: Redwood will apply a single line "Pilot Extension Credit: 30%" on the pilot invoice that Echoware will receive after the pilot concludes. Finance will include a short reference field on the invoice showing the credit and the PO number. That satisfies audit requirements on our side and gives procurement the invoice-level visibility you requested.

- Contracting: we do not require a full LOI. Instead we can provide a two-paragraph addendum (attached as pilot_sow_template.docx) that procurement can attach to the PO; it lists the 14-day extension, acceptance criteria, and conversion window. That addendum is intentionally short so legal review is minimal.

- Ops / Security: David, our platform engineer, will schedule a 60-minute SSO onboarding call and share the SSO checklist. David, can you propose two slots tomorrow at 10:00 and 15:00 PT?

If procurement confirms the PO language is acceptable (i.e., the single-line credit and the addendum attached), Redwood will enact the 14-day extension immediately. Once you confirm, I’ll send the revised invoice language sample and a DocuSign link to attach the addendum.

Next step for procurement: confirm that the wording below is acceptable to appear on the PO/invoice: 

"Pilot Extension Credit: 30% credit applied to pilot invoice (refer to attached addendum), PO# <your PO number>."

Please reply and I’ll circulate the DocuSign + available SSO slots.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0987

Attachments: pilot_sow_template.docx (docx); DocuSign (link: https://docusign.com/loi/abc123)
